title: SFT from Scratch
summary: Turn the tiny GPT you built into an instruction follower with plain PyTorch: format examples with a chat template, mask the loss so only the answer is learned, batch them with a padding collator, order them from easy to hard, run the training loop, and check the result against gold answers.
objectives: Format (instruction, response) pairs with a template and an end marker, and count how many token positions in an example actually contribute to the loss
Build masked labels so the loss covers only the response, and explain what goes wrong if the prompt is left in the loss
Write a collator that pads and truncates a batch, and show that padded positions are ignored by the loss
Order or bucket instruction data to keep batches efficient without breaking the shuffle
Run an SFT loop, read its loss curve, and compare the model's samples with gold responses using exact match and token F1
prerequisites: The GPTModern model from [Modern architecture](/learn/model-foundations/modern-architecture) and the training loop from [Scaling the training loop](/learn/model-foundations/scaling-the-training-loop). The ideas (templates, loss masking, SFT data) are explained in [Instruction tuning](/learn/fine-tuning/instruction-tuning); here you write them by hand.
